note: Background music, instrumental, picked by Jin on 2026-10-16 from two takes per slot. Files live in assets/music/<id>.mp3, all loudness-matched to -14 LUFS (true peak -1 dB). menu_select, fight_nonna and fight_peacock were made with ElevenLabs Music directly (Italian flavour); fight_martino and results with ElevenLabs Music v2.5 on fal.ai, in the style of the reference track Battita di Ferro. Tracks with loop=true are cut on a bar boundary with a 1 s crossfade of the tail into the head, so play them with loop on and no gap; results plays once.

tracks.prompt: Video game menu and character select theme, loopable, instrumental. Playful Italian telenovela flavour: bright mandolin and accordion riff over a bouncy retro arcade synth groove, hand claps, tambourine, warm bass. Cheerful, inviting, a little cheeky. D minor to F major, 126 bpm, steady energy from the first bar, no intro, no fade out, no vocals.

Boss battle music for a video game, loopable, instrumental. An angry Italian grandmother chases heroes around a farm kitchen: frantic tarantella rhythm, accordion and mandolin lead, driving rock drums and distorted bass, brass stabs, clattering pots as percussion accents. Comic but intense, bright and energetic. D minor, 144 bpm, full energy from the first bar, no intro, no fade out, no vocals.

Boss battle music for a video game, loopable, instrumental. A vain peacock shows off in hazelnut woods: flamboyant glam rock with a theatrical, show-off feel, big brass fanfares, electric guitar riff, mandolin flourishes, dramatic timpani rolls, bright and pompous. D minor, 144 bpm, driving energy from the first bar, no intro, no fade out, no vocals.

Instrumental final boss battle theme for a retro arcade fighting game: a little dog turned into a huge monster by AI glasses, fought in Venice. The most epic track of the game. Modern hi-fi chiptune fused with J-rock and orchestral elements, 175 BPM, 4/4. Relentless 16th-note synth bass, heavy compressed drums with big fills, heavy distorted guitars, supersaw walls, frantic chiptune arpeggios, glitchy digital synth textures for the AI glasses. Venetian drama: church organ, choir pads, mandolin tremolo, timpani. Dark urgent minor-key sections building to a heroic, triumphant major-key chorus, an intense shred synth solo. Maximum energy, designed to loop seamlessly, no fade out.
tracks.edit: cut from the 146 s take to a 135 s seamless loop

tracks.prompt: Instrumental victory and results screen music for a retro arcade game, played while the team's time, deaths and MVP are shown. Modern hi-fi chiptune fused with light J-rock, 120 BPM, 4/4, warm major key. Relaxed groove with punchy drums, bouncy synth bass, bright square-wave lead, sparkling arpeggios, a mandolin and accordion melody for an Italian festa feel. Proud, happy and celebratory but calmer than the battle music, a satisfying 'well done' mood. Steady energy, designed to loop seamlessly, no fade out.
